title: Leer's investigation of magnetic anomalies at Coburn's house

tellings.quote: he wanted me to come over and check out my house and we found all kinds of anomalies, anomalous magnetic fields, um leaves and the uh the trunk of the avocado tree had become magnetized.

plain: At a house in Fillmore, California, strange magnetic fields turned up, and even the leaves and trunk of an avocado tree had become magnetized. That is what Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people's bodies, tells Michels about his own home. He says a researcher named Roger Leir wanted to check the house, and together they "found all kinds of anomalies", which Colbern raises as a sign of something unusual going on there.
